notes:
REF-BM-02: Collects title, description, and preview image, but no favicon.
REF-BM-03: Title and description can be edited after saving, but there is no pre-save metadata-editing step.
REF-BM-07: Cards expose title, description, and tags, but not a favicon.
REF-BM-08: The original URL is available through the details dialog, but selecting the list item itself does not navigate there.
REF-BM-12: Search covers title, description, note, site, tags, and captured text, but omits the full URL.
REF-BM-20: Multi-selection supports adding a tag and archiving only; bulk tag removal, read/unread, and delete are missing.
REF-BM-21: Select-all is limited to currently displayed page-size items rather than the whole filtered collection.
REF-BM-23: Notes are stored and rendered as HTML from a rich-text editor; Markdown syntax is not supported.
REF-BM-24: HTML and PDF captures are stored locally, but HTML resources are not bundled into a self-contained single file.
REF-BM-25: No Internet Archive snapshot integration is implemented.
